item.title: ‘Another dot-com bubble?’ How OpenAI, Anthropic IPOs could pressure stocks in 2027
item.description: Paul Tudor Jones warns that 2027 could challenge US stocks as major technology IPOs, share issuance, fiscal deficits and potentially higher oil prices weigh on markets. He sees parallels with 1999 and says rising equity supply could pressure prices.
